final: WITH color_groups AS (SELECT product_color, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM Products GROUP BY product_color), count_average AS (SELECT AVG(product_count) AS avg_count FROM color_groups) SELECT AVG(g.avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price_usd, AVG(g.product_count) AS avg_product_count, AVG(g.product_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_count_difference FROM color_groups AS g JOIN count_average AS a ON a.avg_count IS NOT NULL WHERE g.product_count > a.avg_count
